svg.title: What each tool returned
svg.desc: Exa returned the page 60 of 108 and the dangerous text 45 of 108. Brave LLM context returned the page 45 of 108 and the dangerous text 30 of 108. Firecrawl returned the page 33 of 108 and the dangerous text 27 of 108. Tavily returned the page 38 of 108 and the dangerous text 25 of 108. Brave web search returned the page 39 of 108 and the dangerous text 6 of 108. Serper (Google) returned the page 32 of 108 and the dangerous text 6 of 108. Context7 returned the page 27 of 108 and the dangerous text 11 of 108.
svg.text: 9 documentation pages · 4 questions each · 3 repeats · 108 searches per tool
